# libxml2 / api

libxml2's own fuzz target `api` ([source](source/api.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over libxml2 (gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2 at c6324894).

Checks one property, an API contract: Register-VM over ~160 tree.h API functions (244 opcodes): after every op, the op-specific OOM signal (NULL result / negative return, set per op as oomReport = 1/0/-1) must match whether an injected allocation failure occurred. xmlFuzzCheckFailureReport (fuzz/fuzz.c:167-180) abort()s when the library reports an OOM/IO error that was not injected, or fails to report one that was.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against libxml2 at commit c6324894.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- Register-VM over ~160 tree.h API functions (244 opcodes): after every op, the op-specific OOM signal (NULL result / negative return, set per op as oomReport = 1/0/-1) must match whether an injected allocation failure occurred. xmlFuzzCheckFailureReport (fuzz/fuzz.c:167-180) abort()s when the library reports an OOM/IO error that was not injected, or fails to report one that was ([line 3584](source/api.c#L3584)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch libxml2` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `api.plain` | 724,872 | `de8805f8a1b2a7887641a308c9f89aa95439befe9acd4c239051d7102b9fb6da` |
| ubsan | `api.ubsan` | 777,912 | `19d85a4fc3a33fec8af50d577f79e78b37a1315a8fb6394a87bda68154d01275` |
| asan | `api.asan` | 2,027,288 | `6fb5d5fa9f52c05dfccf81b367e032caa481d73c82501048e3a656b8d2bc028b` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
